messages:
mara: quick heads-up: noticed ~2.8% of SSE streams hit an edge proxy idle timeout after ~14s of silence and clients immediately reconnect, causing duplicate token consumption. console shows no quota events. :confused:

josh: is this edge-proxy-only or also regional LB?

mara: mostly edge-proxy in eu-west1. affects long-running chat streams that have short pauses.

devin: can you paste an obfuscated proxy trace?

mara: sample: 
```
[edge-proxy] conn_id=abc123 route=/v1/chat/stream event=idle_timeout reason=keepalive_miss duration=14.2s upstream=200 client=203.x.x.x
[upstream] req_id=xyz789 status=200 bytes_sent=12k
```

sam: current proxy behavior is to FIN the socket without an SSE "event: close". client sees abrupt close and reconnects. billing counts tokens for original+resumed.

josh: confirmed race: resume token TTL valid server-side, but proxy tombstones session on FIN and routing layer treats immediate reconnect (if resume header missing) as new session. short race ~1-2s.

mara: quick options: 1) increase proxy idle to 30s (fast) 2) emit an SSE ping before closing so client can resume idempotently 3) make resume token binding more resilient (infra work).

sam: we shouldn't widen idle globally. proposal: add per-route header X-Keepalive-Grace default 30s for streaming endpoints, surface in console routes list.

devin: need telemetry first: add metric sse_proxy_early_close{route,region,reason} and alert if >0.5% in 10m.

josh: i'll draft header schema and unit tests for proxy. small canary change only.

mara: i'll ship a hotfix to emit the metric to staging so we can validate. also will add a temporary query to backfill past 72h.

ops-bot: deploy queued: edge-proxy-metrics-v2 -> staging (build 3421).

josh: also a thought: LB-level Connection: keep-alive tweaks might reduce FINs, but need infra sign-off.

devin: i'll add a dashboard panel: "SSE early close rate" per route + region and a drilldown to sample traces.

mara: for rollout: 1) metric -> staging (mara) 2) proxy header handling -> canary (josh) 3) console UI to show grace window (product followup) 4) alert/dashboard (devin) 5) if noisy, default header only for streaming routes.

sam: agree. small, observable steps. if we choose ping-before-close we need to ensure it's idempotent and doesn't count extra tokens.

josh: ping plan: send a zero-byte SSE comment or `event: ping\n\n` to keep socket alive for client v2 behaviour. will prototype.

devin: note: some clients close on any comment; need compatibility check. add opt-out header X-SSE-Ping=off per-route.

mara: ok let's iterate. i'll paste logs and repro in #eng-platform-dumps. thanks all. :thumbsup:
